description:
This image depicts a small, square-shaped food item, possibly a type of cake or pastry, placed alongside a plastic bag containing a smaller, rectangular item.

The food item, situated on the right side of the image, features a light-brown hue with a darker brown color on its right side. The plastic bag, located on the left side of the image, has a blue border around its top and bottom edges. A white sticker with Chinese lettering and red writing is affixed to the top
